test_debug_example: test the gRPC Python debug example by running the DebugExampleTest unittest suite
run_channelz_test: run the test_channelz_example method to verify debug server creation and message sending
create_debug_server: create a gRPC debug server with a configurable failure rate using debug_server.create_server
send_debug_messages: send messages to the debug server using send_message.run with a specified address and count
get_debug_stats: retrieve debug server statistics using get_stats.run with the server address
